thread:
Alex C: Hey team — prepping the LangChain handoff preflight for the marketplace listing + joint announcement. Need a quick sync on artifacts and perf validation we require from the LangChain side and HW partner. High level: marketplace assets (logos, 1-pager, screenshots), a sample app that uses the Redwood SDK + LangChain connector, a perf report (p50/p95, token/sec) on our target instance types, and an internal checklist for legal/marketing approvals.

Priya S: Thanks Alex. Quick checklist idea:
- integration smoke tests (CI badge)
- sample app + deploy script (Dockerfile + Compose)
- automated e2e that runs generation + embeddings
- SSO details if they want a demo tenant
- logos (SVG/PNG), one-sentence blurb, 400-word partner writeup
- PR draft & embargo date

Kevin M: I can take perf. Can LangChain provide a representative prompt set? We need:
- 100 warm runs, seq len ~512/avg
- batch sizes 1,4,8
- KV cache hit sim
- target hw: g5.2x / a100-sxm4 (we'll run both)
- metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, memory high-water mark, VRAM config

Liz T: Marketing: aim for a week after we have verified marketplace package and legal signoff. Would like screenshots of the sample app UI + a short 60s demo video. Also confirm co-marketing assets + logo usage.

Alex C: Kevin — can you also include a small curl snippet that partners can run against a dev endpoint to validate connectivity? Something like: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://dev.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-compat-lc","input":"Summarize: The quick brown fox","max_tokens":64}'
```
Mark it as non-prod and put allowed rate limits.

Priya S: Good. I'll assemble the marketplace checklist in a repo under partners/langchain-handoff and add a README with the exact artifacts. Also will request legal checklist: logos, trademark language, and partner contract snippet.

vendor-bot: build #742 on partners/langchain-handoff passed (smoke tests), artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-partners/langchain-742.

Kevin M: Ran initial perf on g5.2x: p50=42ms @ batch1, p95=138ms; batch4 throughput ~2.8k tokens/sec. KV cache improved p95 by ~30% for repeated prefixes. Will run a100-sxm4 next and attach CSV.

Liz T: Timeline proposal:
- Wed: perf CSV + sample app link
- Thu: marketing assets in drive + PR draft
- Mon (next week): legal signoff
- Tue (next week): soft launch to selected accounts, Wed public listing/announce

Alex C: Owners: Kevin -> perf + CSV (due Wed EOD), Priya -> repo + legal intake (Thu EOD), Liz -> marketing assets + PR (Thu EOD). I'll coordinate with HW partner for their logo and short quote.

Priya S: FYI tagging @LangChain (external) re: prompt set and CI badge. Also adding a compatibility note: recommended model variants & quantization profiles for edge deployments.

Kevin M: Uploading perf CSV now: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/langchain/perf-1768401234.csv

Alex C: Great — once we have perf + sample app + assets we'll schedule a dry-run of the install experience with partner engineering. Keep updates here, please. :rocket:

Liz T: Noted. I'll prep the PR template and a marketing brief.

Alex C: Thanks all. Quick ask: if any blocker (legal/tech) appears, call it out ASAP so we don't slip the announce window.
